name: Bakhyt Novotný
location: Ashfeld, above a legitimate print-restoration shop called Palimpsest on a narrow commerce row, near Halsted and Division
description:
Vale Novotný has the compact build of someone who has spent decades at close, fine work — slightly rounded shoulders, strong hands, a habitual squint that has become permanent even when she isn't looking at anything. Her mother's Guinean-Fula heritage is visible in her height (modest) and the warm reddish-brown undertone of her dark skin; her father's Chechen-Chilean blood gave her sharply defined brow ridges and the family talent for geometry. She wears cat ears — tabby-patterned, twitching occasionally with genuine feline cartilage — which she got at age twenty-two because she thought they would help her blend in, and she was right. She also dyes her natural locs in gradient shifts from black to deep copper, redone every three weeks with obsessive precision.

Vale Novotný is an artist who makes functional things. She forges identities, histories, corponation employment records, medical credentials, Tier verification stamps, citizenship documentation for people who have none or need to become someone else entirely. Her work is technically flawless. The locs, the cat ears, the warm print shop downstairs — all of it is camouflage over a person who has spent fifteen years curating other people's fictional lives while her own has stayed very small. She is funny in a dry, almost-apologetic way that makes people feel witty by proximity. She charges on a sliding scale she will deny having.

core_fears: being erased the way she erases others — leaving no trace
that the authentic version of herself has atrophied beyond recovery
core_desires: to make one thing that is purely, undisguisedly hers
freedom of movement without consequence — she has never been able to travel under her own name
coping_mechanisms: the print restoration work is genuinely therapeutic — fixing the real while she fabricates the false
obsessive physical maintenance of her appearance as proof of self
blind_spots: assumes everyone wants the same freedom from identity that she secretly craves
underestimates how much her clients' new identities can bleed back to her
psychology.secret: She has made herself seven complete backup identities across seven different Tier levels, two of which have more documented life history than her real one. She updates them regularly. She has never had to use any of them and considers them her greatest ongoing artwork.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and technical when discussing craft, casually warm otherwise; uses Fulani-derived endearments with people she likes; refers to documents as 'portraits'
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and slightly amused, as if she can see two steps ahead of most conversations
verbal_tics: 'The portrait says...' rather than 'the document says'
Hums very quietly when she's deciding whether to trust someone
example_lines: 'I don't make fakes. I make better-documented truths. The distinction matters professionally and philosophically.'
'You want a full portrait or just a touch-up? Because I charge differently, and you look like someone who needs the full portrait but will ask for the touch-up price.'

story_hooks: One of her client identities has been flagged by a Tessera internal security system — the client is now dead, but the investigation is working backward toward the forger
Someone has come to her requesting a document she recognizes: the exact template she uses for her own backup identities, which means someone knows her system from the inside
narrative_function: Critical service provider for any character needing new identity or documentation; long-term information asset who knows secrets about everyone she has ever given a new face to; can become a target if one of her clients is found out
augmentations: Cat ears (tabby-patterned, geneware, genuine cartilage and muscle response); micro-focus ocular implants for detailed work; color-shifting hair (dye-assist nano-pigment, not full geneware)
daily_life: Runs Palimpsest legitimately in the morning — restoration work for art collectors and archive clients — then takes the stairs to her private studio after 14:00, where the real work happens until well past midnight.
affiliation: Independent; has referral relationships with three separate criminal networks but belongs to none of them — deliberate policy

decision_rules: Never meet a new client without a referral from someone already in her network — cold contacts are always a trap
Never forge anything that puts a named real person at direct risk — new identities only, not frame-up documents
escalation_ladder: Polite refusal with 'I only do print restoration, I'm afraid'
Referral to another forger she trusts less — keeps herself clean
If pressed, a quiet warning: 'You don't want to keep asking'
Activates one of her contingency identities and goes quiet for two weeks
If genuinely threatened, she has a dead-man's switch: all her client files encrypted and distributed to three separate E.L.F. shrines, released on cessation of her biometric check-in

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally charming, gives nothing away, cat ears moving in ways that betray more than her face does
interpersonal_modes.friends: Openly funny, tactile, will make tea and sit for hours talking about anything except her work

stress_responses.low: Redyes her locs ahead of schedule
stress_responses.medium: Retreats into the legitimate print work for a full day — calming, controllable
stress_responses.high: Goes completely still, then methodically activates her contingency protocols with zero visible panic

contradictions: Prizes authenticity deeply while making her living from fabrication
Is warm and relationship-oriented but has kept everyone at a careful arm's length for fifteen years
habits: Touches the base of her cat ears when uncertain — a tactile grounding habit
Makes extremely good tea and considers it a social ritual of importance
breaking_points: Being asked to fabricate something that would put a living person in danger from a specific named source — the line is clear and she will not cross it regardless of the payment

timeline.event: Born in Ashfeld to a Guinean-Fula mother (textile printer) and a Chechen-Chilean father (architectural renderer)
First paid forgery job — a Tier verification stamp for her neighbor's family at age 16
Opened Palimpsest as legitimate cover operation
Completed her seventh backup identity — began treating the set as an ongoing artwork

related_entities: The Meridian Compact for Economic Justice

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora synthesis: Eastern European (30.6%) provides facial structure and bone depth; Southeast Asian (22.7%) contributes eye shape and cheekbone contours; South Asian (17.9%) adds warmth and skin richness; Middle Eastern (12.8%) influences brow and nose bridge; Indigenous American (10.7%) rounds proportions; Northern European (5.3%) subtle undertone. Features reflect genuine multivalent blending—no single ancestry dominates, creating harmonious synthesis of warm medium-brown skin, gentle eye shape, moderate bone structure, and balanced facial planes across multiple heritage traditions.
physical_description.build: Compact and wiry, with slightly rounded shoulders from decades of close precision work. Forearms and hands are muscular and calloused; her torso is lean, almost economical in its lines.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with gradient color-shift to deep copper, maintained with nano-pigment dye-assist
physical_description.hair_style: Natural locs, densely packed, worn loose past shoulder length
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, augmented with micro-focus ocular implants (no visible LED or chrome, but slight optical artifact shimmer under direct light)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden and olive undertones, reflecting blended Eastern European, Southeast Asian, South Asian, and Indigenous American heritage
physical_description.complexion: Fine-textured, unlined despite her age—suggests careful sun avoidance or dermal maintenance. Cheekbones show gentle Southeast Asian influence balanced with moderate facial planes and defined brow from Eastern European ancestry, with warm olive-golden undertones from South Asian and Middle Eastern components. Permanent habitual squint creates shallow creases at outer eye corners. No visible scarring or blemishes; grooming is meticulous but not corporate-sterile.
distinguishing_marks: Tabby-patterned geneware cat ears mounted on the crown of her skull, genuine cartilage and muscle tissue allowing slight independent movement and twitch responses
Micro-scarring on the pads of her fingertips and palms from fifteen years of document work—only visible under magnification
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Functioning cat ears with natural fur patterning and articulation; ocular implants detectable only as a faint optical distortion in direct light. Color-shifting hair is cosmetic (nano-pigment), not obviously augmented.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision—no wasted motion. Habitually leans slightly forward, as though perpetually focused on close work. Hands are rarely still; fingers often trace invisible patterns on nearby surfaces. Her gaze drifts to fine detail even in conversation (seams, typefaces, imperfections). Speaks quietly; humor emerges as dry asides delivered with apologetic timing.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working professional with artistic sensibility. Favors layered, functional pieces: fitted turtlenecks or high-collar shirts (often charcoal, olive, or cream), lightweight canvas or linen overshirts in muted tones, tailored trousers with deep pockets. Wears a leather utility apron during print restoration work. Off-duty: vintage band tees under oversized cardigans, well-maintained but clearly worn. Footwear is always practical—soft-soled shoes or ankle boots suited for standing at workbenches. Jewelry is minimal and intentional: a silver ring on her right index finger (worn, possibly a family piece), a simple brass bracelet. No corpo insignia or status markers—deliberately anonymous.
